errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer with the given customer_id is not found in the database.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given category_id is not found in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product with the given product_id is not found in the database.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order with the given order_id is not found in the database.

errors.name: OrderItemNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an OrderItem with the given order_item_id is not found in the description.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice with the given invoice_id is not found in the database.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is neither 'pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', nor 'cancelled'.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that would exceed the available stock of a product.

errors.name: InvalidQuantityError
errors.description: Raised when a quantity in an order item is not a positive integer.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Raised when a product's price is not a positive number.

errors.name: InvalidInvoiceNumberError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice number is not a valid alphanumeric string.

errors.name: DuplicateInvoiceNumberError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to create an invoice with a duplicate invoice number.

errors.name: InvalidOrderItemError
errors.description: Raised when an order item is invalid (e.g., product not found, quantity too high).

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when a CSV file is malformed or contains invalid data.

errors.name: PermissionDeniedError
errors.description: Raised when an unauthorized user attempts to perform an admin operation.

errors.name: InvalidInputError
errors.description: Raised when input data is invalid for any entity (e.g., non-numeric IDs, invalid email format).
